name: ecommerce-commerce-customers-filament
description: Filament panel surface for the merchant's file on a person who shops with them.
features: Customer files listed and searched by their non-identifying reference
Nothing identifying is searchable, sortable or filterable anywhere in the panel
Profile form that requires exactly what the schema requires, which is nothing
Immutable addresses revised, superseded and defaulted through domain actions
Declared group memberships joined and left, never deleted
Lifecycle decisions offering only the transitions the domain permits
File merges confirmed by naming both files by reference
Redaction that says on screen that it spans every tenant
Purchase history rendered as unavailable rather than as zero when Orders is absent
Lifetime value rendered per currency, never folded into one number
Every unpublished Filament ability forced closed by name
